newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Oct 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Oct 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwaiti elections to be held on Monday.
- UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan and Clinton discuss developments in the Gulf and the peace process.
- Budget to complete infrastructure projects in Dubai amounts to 9.5 billion dirhams.
- Qatar will not withdraw its case from the World Court over its territorial dispute with Bahrain.
- 10 million dirhams in losses due to VISA card fraud in the UAE.
- South Africa seeks to strengthen economic ties with Dubai.
